positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationRemoval
positions.frame: what knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration should be removed and on what basis?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the removal of Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration knowledge: src-1 and src-2 are directives to forget and remove all knowledge about the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work, while src-3 supplies the declarative basis — that the observatory never calibrated it. The set holds a mild tension between imperative (forget/remove) and declarative (never happened) voices, but both serve the same directional read of what calibration knowledge to eliminate.
